title: Aislamiento tenant — aplicación, servicios y API
findings: Tenant authority is resolved server-side from active UsuarioEmpresa membership and current Usuario, Empresa and Rol state.
Client-provided EmpresaId is treated only as tenant selection and cannot grant authority.
Effective role authority derives from UsuarioEmpresa.RolId and fail-closes when membership or related tenant state is invalid.
The recovery commit keeps legacy IUsuarioScopeService implementations fail-closed by returning null for the tenant-aware overload unless they implement the contract explicitly.
The recovery delta is limited to IUsuarioScopeService contract compatibility and does not broaden authorization or create an alternate authority path.
